heading: Enter Website Link
label: Link to the page you want to read:
connection_lost_error: Connection to server lost. The page may be taking too long to load.
medium_challenge_error: Medium served an anti-bot challenge and Freedium / archive.org / archive.today all came back empty. The article may be too new to have been archived yet.
challenge_error: The site served an anti-bot challenge (Cloudflare or similar) and no usable snapshot was found on archive.org or archive.today. This site is actively blocking automated requests.
timeout_error: The website took too long to respond (30s timeout). Try again later.
connection_error: Could not connect to the website. Check the URL and try again.
unexpected_error: Unexpected error while fetching the page.
bookmarklet_hint: Drag this to your bookmarks bar. On any article you're reading in your own browser, including ones you subscribe to, click it to open that page in Reader view.
reader_empty: Couldn't find the article text on this page. Try the original page instead.
tidy_working_note: Asking the AI how this page should be laid out. It only arranges what's already here and never rewrites it. This can take a minute.
tidy_done: Tidied by {model} in {seconds}s: {headings} headings added, {joined} pieces joined, {lists} lists, {dropped} words of clutter removed. The wording is unchanged.
library_lede: Copies of pages you kept, saved on this computer with their styles, images and fonts, so they open later, even without an internet connection.
library_empty: Nothing here yet. Press 📌 Keep a copy on a page 9001ft opened, or use the bookmarklet below on any page open in your own browser.
library_add_label: Keep a copy of a link
library_saved_skipped: Some of its files ({count}) couldn't be saved, so the copy may look a little different.
library_delete_confirm: Delete your copy of “{title}”? This can't be undone.
library_bookmarklet_heading: Keep pages from your own browser
library_bookmarklet_hint: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B shows the bar, or ⌘+Shift+B on a Mac). Then, on any page open in your browser, including ones you're signed in to, click it to keep a copy here exactly as you see it.
library_bookmarklet_click: Drag the button to your bookmarks bar rather than clicking it here.
library_confirm_text: 9001ft will save this page on this computer with its styles, images, fonts and scripts, so you can read it later, even offline. Big pages can take a minute.
library_confirm_browser: This is the page as your browser sent it.
library_saving: Saving… this can take a minute.
library_error_expired: This page has expired. Go back, reload it and try again.
library_error_draft: That page is no longer waiting to be kept. Send it again.
library_error_private: Pages on your own network can't be kept.
